		else *staged = std::move(request);
		if (m_PresentationBoxEdit.strOccurrenceId == box.strOccurrenceId) Copy_PresentationPlacement(box, m_PresentationBoxEdit, false);
	}
	for (const auto& box : boxes)
		if (!Request_PresentationGeometryPreview(patternId, box, outStatus))
		{
			outStatus = m_strStatus = "Group geometry is staged for Save; preview is unavailable: " + outStatus;
			return true;
		}
	outStatus = m_strStatus = "Moved the Collider selection around its shared center. Timing and sizes are unchanged; Save keeps the geometry.";
	return true;
}

bool_t Client::CKoukuSaydonActionWorkbench::Render_ColliderGroupDetails(
	const KOUKU_SAYDON_COMPOSITION_PATTERN& pattern)
{
	if (m_strTimelineSelectionPatternId != pattern.strPatternId ||
		m_TimelineSelectedStageIds.size() + m_TimelineSelectedOccurrenceIds.size() < 2u) return false;
	bool anyCollider = false, anyGroup = false, onlyColliders = m_TimelineSelectedStageIds.empty();
	for (const auto& id : m_TimelineSelectedOccurrenceIds)
	{
		const auto* box = Find_PresentationBox(pattern, id);
		const auto* resource = box ? Find_PresentationResource(m_Draft, box->strResourceId) : nullptr;
		anyCollider |= resource && resource->eKind == KOUKU_SAYDON_PRESENTATION_KIND::COLLIDER;
		onlyColliders &= resource && resource->eKind == KOUKU_SAYDON_PRESENTATION_KIND::COLLIDER;
		anyGroup |= box && !box->strSelectionGroupId.empty();
	}
	if (!anyCollider) return false;
	ImGui::SeparatorText("Collider selection");
	ImGui::Text("%zu boxes selected", m_TimelineSelectedOccurrenceIds.size() + m_TimelineSelectedStageIds.size());
	std::vector<KOUKU_SAYDON_COMPOSITION_PRESENTATION_OCCURRENCE> boxes;
	std::string reason;
	const bool valid = m_TimelineSelectedStageIds.empty() &&
		Collect_ColliderPlacements(pattern.strPatternId, m_TimelineSelectedOccurrenceIds, boxes, reason);
	if (!m_TimelineSelectedStageIds.empty()) reason = "Select only Collider boxes to group or transform them.";
	const bool sameGroup = valid && !boxes.front().strSelectionGroupId.empty() &&
		std::all_of(boxes.begin(), boxes.end(), [&](const auto& box) { return box.strSelectionGroupId == boxes.front().strSelectionGroupId; });
	const std::string patternId = pattern.strPatternId;
	ImGui::BeginDisabled(!valid || sameGroup);
	const bool setGroup = ImGui::Button("Set Group");
	ImGui::EndDisabled();
	ImGui::SameLine();
	ImGui::BeginDisabled(!anyGroup || !m_TimelineSelectedStageIds.empty());
	const bool ungroup = ImGui::Button("Ungroup");
	ImGui::EndDisabled();
	ImGui::SameLine();
	ImGui::BeginDisabled(!onlyColliders);
	const bool duplicate = ImGui::Button("Duplicate (same time)##ColliderGroup");
	ImGui::EndDisabled();
	if (duplicate)
	{
		std::string status;
		(void)Dispatch_CompositionEdit(COMPOSITION_EDIT_COMMAND::DUPLICATE_SELECTION, {}, {},
            [&](std::string& message) { return Duplicate_TimelineSelection(patternId, {}, m_TimelineSelectedOccurrenceIds, message, true); }, status);
		return true;
	}
	if (setGroup || ungroup)
	{
		std::string status;
		(void)Set_ColliderSelectionGroup(patternId, m_TimelineSelectedOccurrenceIds, setGroup, status);
		return true;
	}
	if (onlyColliders && anyGroup)
	{
		ImGui::SeparatorText("Individual Colliders");
		ImGui::TextWrapped("Edit a member to tune its Collider and Logic while keeping the group. Horizontal distance is in 4. Logic.");
		std::size_t memberIndex = 0u;
		for (const auto& id : m_TimelineSelectedOccurrenceIds)
		{
			const auto* member = Find_PresentationBox(pattern, id);
			const auto* definition = member ? Find_PresentationResource(m_Draft, member->strResourceId) : nullptr;
			if (!member || !definition || member->strSelectionGroupId.empty()) continue;
			const std::string label = "Edit " + std::to_string(++memberIndex) + ": " + definition->strDisplayName + " (" + std::to_string(member->iStartMs) + " ms)##" + id;
			if (ImGui::Selectable(label.c_str()))
			{
				std::string status;
				(void)Select_ColliderGroupMemberById(patternId, id, status);
				return true;
			}
			if (ImGui::IsItemHovered()) ImGui::SetTooltip("%s", id.c_str());
		}
	}
	if (!valid) { ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", reason.c_str()); return true; }
	if (sameGroup) ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", boxes.front().strSelectionGroupId.c_str());
	ImGui::TextWrapped("One click selects a saved group. Drag its middle to move the complete timeline group. Edit a member above for individual values, or Ungroup to remove the group.");
	std::string selectionKey = patternId;
	std::vector<std::string> sortedIds = m_TimelineSelectedOccurrenceIds;
	std::sort(sortedIds.begin(), sortedIds.end());
	for (const auto& id : sortedIds) selectionKey += "\n" + id;
	if (selectionKey != m_strColliderSelectionTransformKey)
	{ m_strColliderSelectionTransformKey = std::move(selectionKey); m_fColliderSelectionYaw = 0.f; }
	std::array<double, 3u> center{};
	for (const auto& box : boxes)
		for (std::size_t axis = 0u; axis < 3u; ++axis) center[axis] += box.PositionOffset[axis] / double(boxes.size());
	float position[3] = {float(center[0]), float(center[1]), float(center[2])};
	const bool moved = ImGui::DragFloat3("Group center offset (m)", position, .05f, -100000.f, 100000.f, "%.3f");
	float yaw = m_fColliderSelectionYaw;
	const bool rotated = ImGui::DragFloat("Group Y rotation (degrees)", &yaw, .1f, -36000.f, 36000.f, "%.3f");
	ImGui::TextDisabled("Pivot: average of Collider centers in the shared Boss anchor. Rotation is relative to this selection.");
	if (moved || rotated)
	{
		std::array<double, 3u> translation{};
		if (moved) for (std::size_t axis = 0u; axis < 3u; ++axis) translation[axis] = double(position[axis]) - center[axis];
		std::string status;
		if (Transform_SelectedColliders(translation, double(yaw) - m_fColliderSelectionYaw, status)) m_fColliderSelectionYaw = yaw;
	}
	return true;
}

bool_t Client::CKoukuSaydonActionWorkbench::Collect_EffectPlacements(
	const std::string_view patternId, const std::vector<std::string>& occurrenceIds,
	std::vector<KOUKU_SAYDON_COMPOSITION_PRESENTATION_OCCURRENCE>& outBoxes, std::string& outStatus) const
{
	outBoxes.clear();
	const auto reject = [&](const char* reason) { outStatus = reason; return false; };
	const auto* pattern = Find_Pattern(m_Draft, patternId);
	if (!pattern || !pattern->strLoadError.empty() || !Pattern_DurationMs(*pattern))
		return reject("Select a valid Pattern before moving Effect groups.");
	auto expandedIds = occurrenceIds;
	Expand_PresentationSelection(*pattern, expandedIds);
	std::unordered_set<std::string> selected;
	for (const auto& id : expandedIds)
	{
		if (!selected.insert(id).second) continue;
		const auto* source = Find_PresentationBox(*pattern, id);
		const auto* resource = source ? Find_PresentationResource(m_Draft, source->strResourceId) : nullptr;
		if (!source || !resource || resource->eKind != KOUKU_SAYDON_PRESENTATION_KIND::EFFECT)
			return reject("Select only Effect boxes from this Pattern.");
		auto box = *source;
		for (const auto& staged : m_StagedPresentationGeometry)
			if (staged.strPatternId == patternId && staged.Occurrence.strOccurrenceId == id)
			{
				if (staged.Occurrence.strResourceId != source->strResourceId)
					return reject("Effect placement identity changed. Reopen the selected group.");
				Copy_PresentationPlacement(staged.Occurrence, box, true);
				break;
			}
		if (!Valid_PresentationPlacement(*resource, box))
			return reject("Correct or revert invalid Effect placement before moving the group.");
		// MAP positions share one world frame even when the effects fire at different times.
		// Moving/frozen BOSS and WORLD offsets must share the exact sampled anchor frame.
		if (!outBoxes.empty() && !(outBoxes.front().strAnchorKind == "MAP" && box.strAnchorKind == "MAP") &&
			!Same_ColliderGroupFrame(outBoxes.front(), box))
			return reject("Group position requires one coordinate frame: fixed MAP, or the same Boss/Object, bone and Follow setting. Frozen Boss/Object anchors also require the same start time. Grouping and timeline movement remain available.");
		outBoxes.push_back(std::move(box));
	}
	if (outBoxes.size() < 2u) return reject("Select at least two Effect boxes.");
	return true;
}

bool_t Client::CKoukuSaydonActionWorkbench::Transform_SelectedEffects(
	const std::array<double, 3u>& translation, const std::array<double, 4u>& rotationDelta,
	std::string& outStatus)
{
	const auto reject = [&](const char* reason) { outStatus = m_strStatus = reason; return false; };
	if (m_ePatternSelection != KOUKU_PATTERN_SELECTION::PATTERN ||
		m_strTimelineSelectionPatternId != m_strSelectedPatternId || !m_TimelineSelectedStageIds.empty())
		return reject("Select only Effect boxes from the current Pattern.");
	if (!std::all_of(translation.begin(), translation.end(), [](double value) { return std::isfinite(value); }) ||
		!std::all_of(rotationDelta.begin(), rotationDelta.end(), [](double value) { return std::isfinite(value); }))
		return reject("Group translation and rotation must be finite. Previous placements are preserved.");
	const double rotationLength = std::hypot(std::hypot(rotationDelta[0], rotationDelta[1]),
		std::hypot(rotationDelta[2], rotationDelta[3]));
	if (!std::isfinite(rotationLength) || rotationLength <= std::numeric_limits<double>::epsilon())
		return reject("Group rotation must be a valid quaternion. Previous placements are preserved.");
	const auto delta = XMVectorSet(float(rotationDelta[0] / rotationLength), float(rotationDelta[1] / rotationLength),
		float(rotationDelta[2] / rotationLength), float(rotationDelta[3] / rotationLength));
	const bool rotated = rotationDelta[0] != 0.0 || rotationDelta[1] != 0.0 || rotationDelta[2] != 0.0;
	DirectX::XMFLOAT4X4 rotation;
	XMStoreFloat4x4(&rotation, XMMatrixRotationQuaternion(delta));
	std::vector<KOUKU_SAYDON_COMPOSITION_PRESENTATION_OCCURRENCE> boxes;
	if (!Collect_EffectPlacements(m_strSelectedPatternId, m_TimelineSelectedOccurrenceIds, boxes, outStatus))
	{ m_strStatus = outStatus; return false; }
	std::array<double, 3u> center{};
	for (const auto& box : boxes)
		for (std::size_t axis = 0u; axis < 3u; ++axis) center[axis] += box.PositionOffset[axis] / double(boxes.size());
	for (auto& box : boxes)
	{
		if (rotated)
		{
			const std::array<double, 3u> relative = {box.PositionOffset[0] - center[0],
				box.PositionOffset[1] - center[1], box.PositionOffset[2] - center[2]};
			for (std::size_t axis = 0u; axis < 3u; ++axis)
				box.PositionOffset[axis] = center[axis] + relative[0] * rotation.m[0][axis] +
					relative[1] * rotation.m[1][axis] + relative[2] * rotation.m[2][axis];
			const auto previous = XMQuaternionRotationRollPitchYaw(XMConvertToRadians(float(box.RotationDegrees[0])),
				XMConvertToRadians(float(box.RotationDegrees[1])), XMConvertToRadians(float(box.RotationDegrees[2])));
			// DirectX row-vector order: rotate the occurrence in its shared anchor after its local rotation.
			DirectX::SimpleMath::Quaternion composed;
			XMStoreFloat4(&composed, XMQuaternionNormalize(XMQuaternionMultiply(previous, delta)));
			const auto angles = composed.ToEuler();
			box.RotationDegrees = {double(XMConvertToDegrees(angles.x)), double(XMConvertToDegrees(angles.y)),
				double(XMConvertToDegrees(angles.z))};
		}
		for (std::size_t axis = 0u; axis < 3u; ++axis) box.PositionOffset[axis] += translation[axis];
		if (!Valid_PresentationGeometry(box))
			return reject("Group transform exceeds an Effect's authoring range. The entire selection is unchanged.");
	}
	const std::string patternId = m_strSelectedPatternId;
	// Stage every validated member before requesting a preview. The first preview
	// preparation and Save both see the complete group, including pending edits.
	Begin_EditHistory();
	for (const auto& box : boxes)
	{
		const auto staged = std::find_if(m_StagedPresentationGeometry.begin(), m_StagedPresentationGeometry.end(),
			[&](const auto& row) { return row.strPatternId == patternId && row.Occurrence.strOccurrenceId == box.strOccurrenceId; });
		KOUKU_PRESENTATION_GEOMETRY_PREVIEW_REQUEST request{patternId, box};
		if (staged == m_StagedPresentationGeometry.end()) m_StagedPresentationGeometry.push_back(std::move(request));
		else *staged = std::move(request);
		if (m_PresentationBoxEdit.strOccurrenceId == box.strOccurrenceId) Copy_PresentationPlacement(box, m_PresentationBoxEdit, true);
	}
	for (const auto& box : boxes)
		if (!Request_PresentationGeometryPreview(patternId, box, outStatus))
		{
			outStatus = m_strStatus = "Group transform is staged for Save; preview is unavailable: " + outStatus;
			return true;
		}
	outStatus = m_strStatus = "Transformed the Effect group. Relative placement, timing and scale are preserved; Save keeps the placement.";
	return true;
}

bool_t Client::CKoukuSaydonActionWorkbench::Render_SoundGroupDetails(
	const KOUKU_SAYDON_COMPOSITION_PATTERN& pattern)
{
	if (m_strTimelineSelectionPatternId != pattern.strPatternId || !m_TimelineSelectedStageIds.empty() ||
		m_TimelineSelectedOccurrenceIds.size() < 2u) return false;
	bool anyGroup = false, sameGroup = true;
	std::string firstGroup;
	for (const auto& id : m_TimelineSelectedOccurrenceIds)
	{
		const auto* box = Find_PresentationBox(pattern, id);
		const auto* resource = box ? Find_PresentationResource(m_Draft, box->strResourceId) : nullptr;
		if (!resource || resource->eKind != KOUKU_SAYDON_PRESENTATION_KIND::SOUND) return false;
		if (id == m_TimelineSelectedOccurrenceIds.front()) firstGroup = box->strSelectionGroupId;
		anyGroup |= !box->strSelectionGroupId.empty();
		sameGroup &= !box->strSelectionGroupId.empty() && box->strSelectionGroupId == firstGroup;
	}
	ImGui::SeparatorText("Sound selection");
	ImGui::Text("%zu boxes selected", m_TimelineSelectedOccurrenceIds.size());
	ImGui::BeginDisabled(sameGroup);
	const bool setGroup = ImGui::Button("Set Group");
	ImGui::EndDisabled();
	ImGui::SameLine();
	ImGui::BeginDisabled(!anyGroup);
	const bool ungroup = ImGui::Button("Ungroup");
	ImGui::EndDisabled();
	if (setGroup || ungroup)
	{
		std::string status;
		(void)Set_SoundSelectionGroup(pattern.strPatternId, m_TimelineSelectedOccurrenceIds, setGroup, status);
		return true;
	}
	if (sameGroup) ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", firstGroup.c_str());
	ImGui::TextWrapped("Drag the middle of any selected Sound box to move the whole selection. Set Group keeps that selection after Save. Each source window, duration, fade and volume stays unchanged. Ungroup to trim individual boxes.");
	return true;
}

bool_t Client::CKoukuSaydonActionWorkbench::Render_EffectGroupDetails(
	const KOUKU_SAYDON_COMPOSITION_PATTERN& pattern)
{
	if (m_strTimelineSelectionPatternId != pattern.strPatternId ||
		!m_TimelineSelectedStageIds.empty() || m_TimelineSelectedOccurrenceIds.empty()) return false;
	if (m_TimelineSelectedOccurrenceIds.size() == 1u)
	{
		const auto* box = Find_PresentationBox(pattern, m_TimelineSelectedOccurrenceIds.front());
		const auto* resource = box ? Find_PresentationResource(m_Draft, box->strResourceId) : nullptr;
		if (!resource || resource->eKind != KOUKU_SAYDON_PRESENTATION_KIND::EFFECT) return false;
		const bool grouped = !box->strSelectionGroupId.empty();
		if (ImGui::Button(grouped ? "Ungroup Effect" : "Set Effect Group"))
		{
			std::string status;
			(void)Set_EffectSelectionGroup(pattern.strPatternId, m_TimelineSelectedOccurrenceIds, !grouped, status);
			return true;
		}
		if (grouped) ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", box->strSelectionGroupId.c_str());
		return false; // A singleton keeps its ordinary timing and placement controls.
	}
	bool anyGroup = false, sameGroup = true;
	std::string firstGroup;
	for (const auto& id : m_TimelineSelectedOccurrenceIds)
	{
		const auto* box = Find_PresentationBox(pattern, id);
		const auto* resource = box ? Find_PresentationResource(m_Draft, box->strResourceId) : nullptr;
		if (!resource || resource->eKind != KOUKU_SAYDON_PRESENTATION_KIND::EFFECT) return false;
		if (id == m_TimelineSelectedOccurrenceIds.front()) firstGroup = box->strSelectionGroupId;
		anyGroup |= !box->strSelectionGroupId.empty();
		sameGroup &= !box->strSelectionGroupId.empty() && box->strSelectionGroupId == firstGroup;
	}
	ImGui::SeparatorText("Effect selection");
	ImGui::Text("%zu boxes selected", m_TimelineSelectedOccurrenceIds.size());
	ImGui::BeginDisabled(sameGroup);
	const bool setGroup = ImGui::Button("Set Group");
	ImGui::EndDisabled();
	ImGui::SameLine();
	ImGui::BeginDisabled(!anyGroup);
	const bool ungroup = ImGui::Button("Ungroup");
	ImGui::EndDisabled();
	if (setGroup || ungroup)
	{
		std::string status;
		(void)Set_EffectSelectionGroup(pattern.strPatternId, m_TimelineSelectedOccurrenceIds, setGroup, status);
		return true;
	}
	if (sameGroup) ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", firstGroup.c_str());
	ImGui::TextWrapped("Drag a grouped box in the timeline to move its timing. Group position and rotation move every member together, keeping its relative placement and timing. Ungroup to edit one member.");
	std::vector<KOUKU_SAYDON_COMPOSITION_PRESENTATION_OCCURRENCE> boxes;
	std::string reason;
	const bool movable = Collect_EffectPlacements(pattern.strPatternId, m_TimelineSelectedOccurrenceIds, boxes, reason);
	if (movable)
	{
		std::vector<std::string> ids;
		for (const auto& box : boxes) ids.push_back(box.strOccurrenceId);
		std::sort(ids.begin(), ids.end());
		std::string key = pattern.strPatternId;
		for (const auto& id : ids) key += "|" + id;
		if (key != m_strEffectSelectionTransformKey)
		{
			m_strEffectSelectionTransformKey = std::move(key);
			m_EffectSelectionRotationDegrees = {};
		}
		std::array<double, 3u> center{};
		for (const auto& box : boxes)
			for (std::size_t axis = 0u; axis < 3u; ++axis) center[axis] += box.PositionOffset[axis] / double(boxes.size());
		float position[3] = {float(center[0]), float(center[1]), float(center[2])};
		const bool fixedMap = boxes.front().strAnchorKind == "MAP";
		const bool moved = ImGui::DragFloat3(fixedMap ? "Group position (world m)" : "Group center offset (m)",
			position, .05f, -100000.f, 100000.f, "%.3f");
		auto angles = m_EffectSelectionRotationDegrees;
		const bool rotated = ImGui::DragFloat3("Group rotation (deg)", angles.data(), .25f, -36000.f, 36000.f, "%.2f");
		if (moved || rotated)
		{
			std::array<double, 3u> translation{};
			if (moved) for (std::size_t axis = 0u; axis < 3u; ++axis) translation[axis] = double(position[axis]) - center[axis];
			std::array<double, 4u> delta = {0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0};
			if (!std::all_of(angles.begin(), angles.end(), [](float value) { return std::isfinite(value) && std::abs(value) <= 36000.f; }))
				m_strStatus = "Group rotation must be finite and within +/-36000 degrees. Previous placements are preserved.";
			else
			{
				if (rotated)
				{
					const auto previous = XMQuaternionRotationRollPitchYaw(XMConvertToRadians(m_EffectSelectionRotationDegrees[0]),
						XMConvertToRadians(m_EffectSelectionRotationDegrees[1]), XMConvertToRadians(m_EffectSelectionRotationDegrees[2]));
					const auto next = XMQuaternionRotationRollPitchYaw(XMConvertToRadians(angles[0]),
						XMConvertToRadians(angles[1]), XMConvertToRadians(angles[2]));
					DirectX::XMFLOAT4 quaternion;
					// Undo the previous group rotation, then apply the new XYZ rotation in the same anchor frame.
					XMStoreFloat4(&quaternion, XMQuaternionNormalize(XMQuaternionMultiply(XMQuaternionInverse(previous), next)));
					delta = {quaternion.x, quaternion.y, quaternion.z, quaternion.w};
				}
				std::string status;
				if (Transform_SelectedEffects(translation, delta, status)) m_EffectSelectionRotationDegrees = angles;
			}
		}
		ImGui::TextDisabled(fixedMap ? "Position is the average of all Effect pivots in world coordinates." :
			"Position is the average of all Effect offsets in the shared anchor.");
		ImGui::TextWrapped("Rotation is relative to this selection and turns every Effect around that center in the shared anchor. Scale and timing stay unchanged.");
	}
	else ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", reason.c_str());
	ImGui::BeginDisabled(!sameGroup);
	const bool duplicate = ImGui::Button("Duplicate Group (same time)");
	ImGui::EndDisabled();
	if (duplicate)
	{
		std::string status;
		(void)Dispatch_CompositionEdit(COMPOSITION_EDIT_COMMAND::DUPLICATE_SELECTION, {}, {},
            [&](std::string& message) { return Duplicate_TimelineSelection(pattern.strPatternId, {}, m_TimelineSelectedOccurrenceIds, message, true); }, status);
		return true;
	}
	ImGui::TextWrapped("The copy keeps the same start times and gets its own group. Change its position to place the sequence at another spot. Ctrl+D duplicates after the selection inside this Pattern; Ctrl+C then Ctrl+V pastes the same linked set at the end of another Pattern.");
	ImGui::BeginDisabled(!Is_Dirty() || Is_PublishRunning());
	const bool save = ImGui::Button(m_bSequenceWorkspace ? "Save Sequence" : "Save Composition");
	ImGui::EndDisabled();
	if (save) { std::string status; (void)Save(status); return true; }
	return true;
}

bool_t Client::CKoukuSaydonActionWorkbench::Copy_TimelineSelection(
	const std::string_view patternId, const std::vector<std::string>& stageIds,
	const std::vector<std::string>& occurrenceIds, std::string& outStatus)
{
	const auto reject = [&](const std::string& reason) { outStatus = m_strStatus = reason; return false; };
	const auto* pattern = m_bHasDraft ? Find_Pattern(m_Draft, patternId) : nullptr;
	if (!pattern || !pattern->strLoadError.empty()) return reject("Copy needs a valid Pattern; previous clipboard preserved.");
	if (stageIds.empty() && occurrenceIds.empty()) return reject("Select timeline boxes to copy.");
	std::unordered_set<std::string> selectedStages(stageIds.begin(), stageIds.end());
	std::unordered_set<std::string> selected(occurrenceIds.begin(), occurrenceIds.end());
	if (selectedStages.size() != stageIds.size() || selected.size() != occurrenceIds.size())
		return reject("Copy selection contains duplicate IDs; previous clipboard preserved.");
	for (const auto& id : selectedStages)
		if (!Find_Stage(*pattern, id)) return reject("Copy Stage is unavailable: " + id);
	for (const auto& id : selected)
		if (!Has_TimelineOccurrence(*pattern, id)) return reject("Copy box is unavailable: " + id);
	auto expanded = occurrenceIds;
	Expand_PresentationSelection(*pattern, expanded);
	selected.insert(expanded.begin(), expanded.end());
	std::string status;
	// The clipboard closes the same ownership links Ctrl+D closes, so Paste never
	// separates a Logic from its hold, regions, summon or an Object from its companion.
	// Unlike a same-Pattern duplicate, a cross-Pattern copy must also carry the Object
	// box a WORLD-anchored row references, because the destination does not own it.
	for (bool grown = true; grown;)
	{
		if (!Expand_TimelineClosure(m_Draft, *pattern, selected, status)) return reject(status + "; previous clipboard preserved.");
		grown = false;
		for (const auto& row : pattern->PresentationOccurrences)
			if (selected.contains(row.strOccurrenceId) && !row.strWorldOccurrenceId.empty())
				grown |= selected.insert(row.strWorldOccurrenceId).second;
	}
	TIMELINE_CLIPBOARD clipboard;
	std::uint64_t first = MAX_EDITOR_TIME_MS, last = 0u, base = 0u;
	const auto include = [&](const std::uint64_t start, const std::uint64_t duration) {
		first = (std::min)(first, start); last = (std::max)(last, start + duration);
	};
	std::unordered_set<std::string> animations;
	std::vector<std::pair<std::uint64_t, const KOUKU_SAYDON_COMPOSITION_ANIMATION_OCCURRENCE*>> animationOrder;
	for (const auto& stage : pattern->Stages)
	{
		const bool whole = selectedStages.contains(stage.strStageId);
		if (whole) include(base, stage.iDurationMs);
		for (const auto& box : stage.AnimationOccurrences)
		{
			animationOrder.emplace_back(base + box.iStartOffsetMs, &box);
			if (whole || selected.contains(box.strOccurrenceId))
			{
				animations.insert(box.strOccurrenceId);
				include(base + box.iStartOffsetMs, box.iPlayMs);
			}
		}
		base += stage.iDurationMs;
	}
	if (!animations.empty())
	{
		// A transition travels only when both of its clips travel; a one-sided
		// blend would otherwise point at a clip the destination never receives.
		std::vector<KOUKU_SAYDON_ANIMATION_BLEND_WINDOW> blends;
		if (!CKoukuSaydonCompositionDocument::Try_ResolveAnimationBlendWindows(m_Draft, *pattern, blends, status))
			return reject("Copy cannot resolve the original animation transition: " + status);
		for (const auto& window : blends)
		{
			const bool sourceSelected = animations.contains(window.Source.strOccurrenceId);
			const bool targetSelected = animations.contains(window.Target.strOccurrenceId);
			if (sourceSelected && targetSelected) selected.insert(window.strLogicOccurrenceId);
			else if (sourceSelected || targetSelected)
			{
				selected.erase(window.strLogicOccurrenceId);
				++clipboard.iDetachedBoundaryBlends;
			}
		}
	}
	std::sort(animationOrder.begin(), animationOrder.end(), [](const auto& a, const auto& b) {
		return a.first != b.first ? a.first < b.first : a.second->strOccurrenceId < b.second->strOccurrenceId;
	});
	for (std::size_t i = 0u; i < animationOrder.size(); ++i)
		if (animations.contains(animationOrder[i].second->strOccurrenceId) && animationOrder[i].second->iBlendInMs &&
			(!i || !animations.contains(animationOrder[i - 1u].second->strOccurrenceId) ||
			 animationOrder[i - 1u].first + animationOrder[i - 1u].second->iPlayMs != animationOrder[i].first))
			++clipboard.iDetachedBoundaryBlends;
	const auto includeLane = [&](const auto& rows) {
		for (const auto& row : rows) if (selected.contains(row.strOccurrenceId)) include(row.iStartMs, row.iDurationMs);
	};
	includeLane(pattern->LogicOccurrences); includeLane(pattern->SummonOccurrences); includeLane(pattern->WorldOccurrences);
	includeLane(pattern->SceneProfileOccurrences); includeLane(pattern->PresentationOccurrences); includeLane(pattern->PatternOccurrences);
	if (last <= first || last > MAX_EDITOR_TIME_MS) return reject("Copy needs a positive selection span within 600000 ms.");
	// Value snapshot with the unsaved placements of the selection baked in; later
	// source edits or deletions never reach the clipboard.
	clipboard.Pattern = *pattern;
	for (const auto& pending : m_StagedPresentationGeometry)
	{
		if (pending.strPatternId != patternId || !selected.contains(pending.Occurrence.strOccurrenceId)) continue;
		auto row = std::find_if(clipboard.Pattern.PresentationOccurrences.begin(), clipboard.Pattern.PresentationOccurrences.end(),
			[&](const auto& value) { return value.strOccurrenceId == pending.Occurrence.strOccurrenceId; });
		if (row == clipboard.Pattern.PresentationOccurrences.end()) continue;
		const auto* resource = Find_PresentationResource(m_Draft, row->strResourceId);
		if (!resource) return reject("Copy resource is unavailable: " + row->strResourceId);
		Copy_PresentationPlacement(pending.Occurrence, *row, resource->eKind == KOUKU_SAYDON_PRESENTATION_KIND::EFFECT);
		if (!Valid_PresentationPlacement(*resource, *row) || !Valid_GameplayColliderScale(*resource, *row))
			return reject("Correct the selected presentation placement before Copy; previous clipboard preserved.");
	}
	std::unordered_set<std::string> captured;
	std::string missing;
	const auto captureResource = [&](const std::string& id) {
		if (id.empty() || !captured.insert("resource:" + id).second) return true;
		const auto* resource = Find_PresentationResource(m_Draft, id);
		if (!resource) { missing = "Copy Effect resource definition is unavailable: " + id; return false; }
		clipboard.Resources.push_back(*resource);
		return true;
	};
	const auto captureScene = [&](const std::string& id) {
		if (id.empty() || !captured.insert("scene:" + id).second) return true;
		const auto* scene = Find_SceneProfile(m_Draft, id);
		if (!scene) { missing = "Copy Scene Profile definition is unavailable: " + id; return false; }
		clipboard.SceneProfiles.push_back(*scene);
		return true;
	};
	const auto captureWorld = [&](const std::string& id) {
		if (id.empty() || !captured.insert("world:" + id).second) return true;
		const auto* world = Find_World(m_Draft, id);
		if (!world) { missing = "Copy World definition is unavailable: " + id; return false; }
		clipboard.Worlds.push_back(*world);
		return captureResource(world->strCompanionEffectResourceId);
	};
	const auto captureSummon = [&](const std::string& id) {
		if (id.empty() || !captured.insert("summon:" + id).second) return true;
		const auto* summon = Find_Summon(m_Draft, id);
		if (!summon) { missing = "Copy Summon definition is unavailable: " + id; return false; }
		clipboard.Summons.push_back(*summon);
		return true;
	};
	const auto captureLogic = [&](const std::string& id) {
		if (id.empty() || !captured.insert("logic:" + id).second) return true;
		const auto* logic = Find_Logic(m_Draft, id);
		if (!logic) { missing = "Copy Logic definition is unavailable: " + id; return false; }
		clipboard.Logics.push_back(*logic);
		for (const auto& visual : logic->PursuitVisualIds) if (!captureResource(visual)) return false;
		return captureResource(logic->strContactVisualId) && captureResource(logic->strEffectResourceId) &&
			captureResource(logic->strLightResourceId) && captureResource(logic->strSoundResourceId) &&
			captureScene(logic->strSceneProfileId);
	};
	auto& counts = clipboard.Counts;
	counts[0] = stageIds.size(); counts[1] = animations.size();
	for (const auto& row : pattern->PatternOccurrences) if (selected.contains(row.strOccurrenceId)) ++counts[2];
	for (const auto& row : pattern->LogicOccurrences)
	{
		if (!selected.contains(row.strOccurrenceId)) continue;
		++counts[3];
		if (!captureLogic(row.strLogicId)) return reject(missing);
		for (const auto* outcomes : { &row.OnSuccessLogicIds, &row.OnFailLogicIds, &row.OnTimeoutLogicIds })
			for (const auto& id : *outcomes) if (!captureLogic(id)) return reject(missing);
	}
	for (const auto& row : pattern->SummonOccurrences)
		if (selected.contains(row.strOccurrenceId)) { ++counts[4]; if (!captureSummon(row.strSummonId)) return reject(missing); }
	for (const auto& row : pattern->WorldOccurrences)
		if (selected.contains(row.strOccurrenceId)) { ++counts[5]; if (!captureWorld(row.strWorldId)) return reject(missing); }
	for (const auto& row : pattern->SceneProfileOccurrences)
		if (selected.contains(row.strOccurrenceId)) { ++counts[6]; if (!captureScene(row.strSceneProfileId)) return reject(missing); }
	for (const auto& row : clipboard.Pattern.PresentationOccurrences)
	{
		if (!selected.contains(row.strOccurrenceId)) continue;
		if (!captureResource(row.strResourceId)) return reject(missing);
		if (row.strAnchorKind == "WORLD" && !captureWorld(row.strWorldId)) return reject(missing);
		const auto* resource = Find_PresentationResource(m_Draft, row.strResourceId);
		++counts[resource->eKind == KOUKU_SAYDON_PRESENTATION_KIND::EFFECT ? 7u :
			resource->eKind == KOUKU_SAYDON_PRESENTATION_KIND::COLLIDER ? 8u : 9u];
	}
	clipboard.strCompositionId = m_Draft.strCompositionId;
	clipboard.strAreaId = m_Draft.strAreaId;
	clipboard.strActorProfileId = pattern->strActorProfileId;
	clipboard.strGateId = pattern->strGateId;
	clipboard.strTargetBossPlacementId = pattern->strTargetBossPlacementId;
	clipboard.iNextPresentationResourceOrdinal = m_Draft.iNextPresentationResourceOrdinal;
	clipboard.iNextWorldOrdinal = m_Draft.iNextWorldOrdinal;
	clipboard.iNextLogicOrdinal = m_Draft.iNextLogicOrdinal;
	clipboard.iNextSummonOrdinal = m_Draft.iNextSummonOrdinal;
	clipboard.iNextSceneProfileOrdinal = m_Draft.iNextSceneProfileOrdinal;
	clipboard.SelectedStageIds = stageIds;
	clipboard.SelectedOccurrenceIds.assign(selected.begin(), selected.end());
	std::sort(clipboard.SelectedOccurrenceIds.begin(), clipboard.SelectedOccurrenceIds.end());
	m_TimelineClipboard = std::move(clipboard);
	outStatus = m_strStatus = Format_ClipboardSummary("Copied ", m_TimelineClipboard->Counts) + ". Select a destination Pattern and press Ctrl+V.";
	if (m_TimelineClipboard->iDetachedBoundaryBlends)
		outStatus = m_strStatus += " Transitions to unselected clips are excluded from the copy.";
	return true;
}

bool_t Client::CKoukuSaydonActionWorkbench::Paste_TimelineClipboard(
	const std::string_view patternId, std::string& outStatus)
{
	const auto reject = [&](const std::string& reason) { outStatus = m_strStatus = reason; return false; };
	if (!m_bHasDraft || !m_TimelineClipboard) return reject("Copy timeline boxes (Ctrl+C) before Paste.");
	const auto& clipboard = *m_TimelineClipboard;
	if (clipboard.strCompositionId != m_Draft.strCompositionId || clipboard.strAreaId != m_Draft.strAreaId)
		return reject("The clipboard belongs to a different Composition or Area; current draft preserved.");
	auto candidate = m_Draft;
	auto* pattern = Find_Pattern(candidate, patternId);
	if (!pattern || !pattern->strLoadError.empty()) return reject("Paste needs a valid destination Pattern.");
	const std::string targetId = pattern->strPatternId;
	// A deleted shared definition comes back from the snapshot; a changed one is
	// refused so Paste never silently rewrites what the author edited since Copy.
	std::size_t restored = 0u;
	const auto restore = [&](const auto& snapshots, auto& rows, std::uint32_t& ordinal, const std::uint32_t copiedOrdinal,
		const char* kind, auto&& find, auto&& idOf) {
		for (const auto& snapshot : snapshots)
		{
			if (const auto* current = find(candidate, idOf(snapshot)))
			{
				if (*current != snapshot) return reject(std::string("Copied ") + kind + " definition changed; copy again: " + idOf(snapshot));
			}
			else
			{
				rows.push_back(snapshot);
				ordinal = (std::max)(ordinal, copiedOrdinal);
				++restored;
			}
		}
		return true;
	};
	if (!restore(clipboard.Resources, candidate.PresentationResources, candidate.iNextPresentationResourceOrdinal, clipboard.iNextPresentationResourceOrdinal, "Effect resource",
			[](const auto& document, const std::string& id) { return Find_PresentationResource(document, id); }, [](const auto& row) -> const std::string& { return row.strResourceId; }) ||
		!restore(clipboard.Worlds, candidate.Worlds, candidate.iNextWorldOrdinal, clipboard.iNextWorldOrdinal, "World",
			[](const auto& document, const std::string& id) { return Find_World(document, id); }, [](const auto& row) -> const std::string& { return row.strWorldId; }) ||
		!restore(clipboard.Logics, candidate.Logics, candidate.iNextLogicOrdinal, clipboard.iNextLogicOrdinal, "Logic",
			[](const auto& document, const std::string& id) { return Find_Logic(document, id); }, [](const auto& row) -> const std::string& { return row.strLogicId; }) ||
		!restore(clipboard.Summons, candidate.Summons, candidate.iNextSummonOrdinal, clipboard.iNextSummonOrdinal, "Summon",
			[](const auto& document, const std::string& id) { return Find_Summon(document, id); }, [](const auto& row) -> const std::string& { return row.strSummonId; }) ||
		!restore(clipboard.SceneProfiles, candidate.SceneProfiles, candidate.iNextSceneProfileOrdinal, clipboard.iNextSceneProfileOrdinal, "Scene Profile",
			[](const auto& document, const std::string& id) { return Find_SceneProfile(document, id); }, [](const auto& row) -> const std::string& { return row.strSceneProfileId; }))
		return false;
	const std::unordered_set<std::string> stageSet(clipboard.SelectedStageIds.begin(), clipboard.SelectedStageIds.end());
	const std::unordered_set<std::string> boxSet(clipboard.SelectedOccurrenceIds.begin(), clipboard.SelectedOccurrenceIds.end());
	for (const auto& stage : clipboard.Pattern.Stages)
	{
		const bool whole = stageSet.contains(stage.strStageId);
		for (const auto& row : stage.AnimationOccurrences)
		{
			if (!whole && !boxSet.contains(row.strOccurrenceId)) continue;
			if (CKoukuSaydonCompositionDocument::Resolve_ActorProfileId(row.strProfileId) != pattern->strActorProfileId)
				return reject("Cannot paste Animation clips onto a different actor profile; current draft preserved.");
			if (!Validate_SourceStart(row, outStatus)) return reject(outStatus);
		}
	}
	for (const auto& row : clipboard.Pattern.PresentationOccurrences)
		if (boxSet.contains(row.strOccurrenceId) && !row.strBone.empty() && row.strAnchorKind == "BOSS" &&
			clipboard.strActorProfileId != pattern->strActorProfileId)
			return reject("Cannot paste a bone-bound Effect onto a different actor profile.");
	const bool patternRows = std::any_of(clipboard.Pattern.PatternOccurrences.begin(), clipboard.Pattern.PatternOccurrences.end(),
		[&](const auto& row) { return boxSet.contains(row.strOccurrenceId); });
	if (patternRows)
	{
		if (!Find_TimelineParent(candidate, targetId)) return reject("Pattern rows can only be pasted into a Parent timeline; current draft preserved.");
		for (const auto& row : clipboard.Pattern.PatternOccurrences)
			if (boxSet.contains(row.strOccurrenceId) && row.strPatternId == targetId) return reject("Cannot paste a Parent into itself.");
		if (clipboard.strGateId != pattern->strGateId || clipboard.strActorProfileId != pattern->strActorProfileId ||
			clipboard.strTargetBossPlacementId != pattern->strTargetBossPlacementId)
			return reject("Pattern rows need a destination with the same Gate, actor and target boss.");
	}
	TIMELINE_CLONE_RESULT result;
	if (!Clone_TimelineSelectionInto(candidate, clipboard.Pattern, *pattern, clipboard.SelectedStageIds,
		clipboard.SelectedOccurrenceIds, TIMELINE_CLONE_MODE::PASTE_APPEND, result, outStatus)) return reject(outStatus);
	if (!Extend_PatternLifetimeForAuthoredLanes(*pattern, outStatus)) return reject(outStatus);
	Mark_Draft(candidate, *pattern);
	std::string summary = Format_ClipboardSummary("Pasted ", clipboard.Counts) +
		(result.bPlacedFromZero ? " placed from 0 ms into the empty Pattern" : " at the Pattern end");
	if (restored) summary += " (restored " + std::to_string(restored) + " definitions)";
	summary += ". Existing clocks preserved. Press Save.";
	if (!Commit_Candidate(std::move(candidate), summary, outStatus)) return false;
	Select_ClonedTimelineRows(targetId, std::move(result));
	return true;
}

bool_t Client::CKoukuSaydonActionWorkbench::Clone_TimelineSelectionInto(
	KOUKU_SAYDON_COMPOSITION_DOCUMENT& candidate, const KOUKU_SAYDON_COMPOSITION_PATTERN& source,
	KOUKU_SAYDON_COMPOSITION_PATTERN& target, const std::vector<std::string>& stageIds,
	const std::vector<std::string>& occurrenceIds, const TIMELINE_CLONE_MODE mode,
	TIMELINE_CLONE_RESULT& outResult, std::string& outStatus)
{
	// DUPLICATE modes assume source is a value copy of target taken before any
	// edit; PASTE_APPEND takes the clipboard snapshot and another Pattern.
	const bool paste = mode == TIMELINE_CLONE_MODE::PASTE_APPEND;
	const bool atOriginalTime = mode == TIMELINE_CLONE_MODE::DUPLICATE_SAME_TIME;
	const std::string verb = paste ? "Paste" : "Duplicate";
	const auto reject = [&](const std::string& message) { outStatus = message; return false; };
	auto* pattern = &target;
	const std::string targetId = target.strPatternId;
	std::unordered_set<std::string> selectedStages(stageIds.begin(), stageIds.end());
	auto expandedIds = occurrenceIds;
	Expand_PresentationSelection(source, expandedIds);
	std::unordered_set<std::string> selected(expandedIds.begin(), expandedIds.end());
	for (const auto& id : selectedStages)
		if (!Find_Stage(source, id)) return reject(verb + " Stage is unavailable: " + id);
	for (const auto& id : selected)
		if (!Has_TimelineOccurrence(source, id)) return reject(verb + " box is unavailable: " + id);
	if (!Expand_TimelineClosure(candidate, source, selected, outStatus)) return false;
	if (atOriginalTime)
	{
		if (!selectedStages.empty() || expandedIds.empty())
			return reject("Same-time duplication requires Effect or Collider boxes.");
		std::optional<KOUKU_SAYDON_PRESENTATION_KIND> selectedKind;
		for (const auto& id : expandedIds)
		{
			const auto* box = Find_PresentationBox(source, id);
			const auto* resource = box ? Find_PresentationResource(candidate, box->strResourceId) : nullptr;
			if (!resource || (resource->eKind != KOUKU_SAYDON_PRESENTATION_KIND::EFFECT &&
				resource->eKind != KOUKU_SAYDON_PRESENTATION_KIND::COLLIDER) ||
				(selectedKind && *selectedKind != resource->eKind))
				return reject("Same-time duplication requires only Effect boxes or only Collider boxes.");
			selectedKind = resource->eKind;
		}
		for (const auto& id : selected)
		{
			// The existing closure owns a Collider's judging Logic and hold. Copy
			// those rows with their regions; never share the original contact ledger.
			if (*selectedKind == KOUKU_SAYDON_PRESENTATION_KIND::COLLIDER && Find_LogicBox(source, id)) continue;
			const auto* box = Find_PresentationBox(source, id);
			const auto* resource = box ? Find_PresentationResource(candidate, box->strResourceId) : nullptr;
			if (!resource || resource->eKind != *selectedKind)
				return reject("Same-time duplication supports Effect boxes or Colliders with their owned Logic only. Use Ctrl+D for a full linked sequence.");
		}
	}
	bool lanesSelected = false, animationsSelected = false;
	for (const auto& id : selected)
		if (Find_Occurrence(source, id)) animationsSelected = true; else lanesSelected = true;
	const bool splice = !selectedStages.empty() || animationsSelected;
	std::uint64_t first = MAX_EDITOR_TIME_MS, last = 0, total = 0, insertMs = 0;
	std::size_t insertIndex = 0;
	const auto include = [&](std::uint64_t start, std::uint64_t duration) {
		first = (std::min)(first, start); last = (std::max)(last, start + duration);
	};
	for (const auto& stage : source.Stages)
	{
		if (selectedStages.contains(stage.strStageId)) include(total, stage.iDurationMs);
		for (const auto& box : stage.AnimationOccurrences)
			if (selected.contains(box.strOccurrenceId)) include(total + box.iStartOffsetMs, box.iPlayMs);
		total += stage.iDurationMs;
	}
	const auto includeLane = [&](const auto& rows) {
		for (const auto& row : rows) if (selected.contains(row.strOccurrenceId)) include(row.iStartMs, row.iDurationMs);
	};
	includeLane(source.LogicOccurrences); includeLane(source.SummonOccurrences);
	includeLane(source.WorldOccurrences); includeLane(source.SceneProfileOccurrences); includeLane(source.PresentationOccurrences); includeLane(source.PatternOccurrences);
	total = (std::max)(total, std::uint64_t(source.iDurationMs));
	if (last <= first || last > MAX_EDITOR_TIME_MS) return reject(verb + " requires a positive selection span within 600000 ms.");
	std::unordered_map<std::string, std::string> ids, regionIds;
	auto& newStageSelection = outResult.NewStageIds;
	auto& newBoxSelection = outResult.NewBoxIds;
	std::vector<KOUKU_SAYDON_COMPOSITION_STAGE> stages;
	bool exhausted = false;
	const auto allocate = [&](std::uint32_t& ordinal, const std::string& prefix) {
		if (!ordinal || ordinal >= 1000000u) { exhausted = true; return std::string{}; }
		return prefix + std::to_string(ordinal++);
	};
	const auto cloneStage = [&](KOUKU_SAYDON_COMPOSITION_STAGE copy, const bool selectStage) {
		copy.strStageId = allocate(pattern->iNextStageOrdinal, "STAGE_");
		if (copy.strStageId.empty()) return;
		copy.strActionId = targetId + ".stage." + copy.strStageId.substr(6u);
		if (selectStage) newStageSelection.push_back(copy.strStageId);
		for (auto& box : copy.AnimationOccurrences)
		{
			const auto old = box.strOccurrenceId;
			box.strOccurrenceId = allocate(pattern->iNextAnimationOrdinal, targetId + ".animation.");
			ids.emplace(old, box.strOccurrenceId);
			if (!selectStage || lanesSelected) newBoxSelection.push_back(box.strOccurrenceId);
		}
		stages.push_back(std::move(copy));
	};
	std::uint64_t base = 0, delta = 0;
	if (paste)
	{
		// Append after everything the destination already owns. A placeholder
		// Pattern without any row keeps its explicit lifetime but starts at 0 so
		// the pasted content is not preceded by an idle head.
		std::uint64_t stageEnd = 0u;
		for (const auto& stage : target.Stages) stageEnd += stage.iDurationMs;
		std::uint64_t appendAt = (std::max)(stageEnd, std::uint64_t(Pattern_DurationMs(target)));
		const auto includeEnds = [&](const auto& rows) {
			for (const auto& row : rows) appendAt = (std::max)(appendAt, std::uint64_t(row.iStartMs) + row.iDurationMs);
		};
		includeEnds(target.LogicOccurrences); includeEnds(target.SummonOccurrences); includeEnds(target.WorldOccurrences);
		includeEnds(target.SceneProfileOccurrences); includeEnds(target.PresentationOccurrences); includeEnds(target.PatternOccurrences);
		if (target.BossMotion) appendAt = (std::max)(appendAt, std::uint64_t(target.BossMotion->iEndMs));
		const bool emptyDestination = target.Stages.empty() && target.PatternOccurrences.empty() &&
			target.LogicOccurrences.empty() && target.SummonOccurrences.empty() && target.WorldOccurrences.empty() &&
			target.SceneProfileOccurrences.empty() && target.PresentationOccurrences.empty() && !target.BossMotion;
		if (emptyDestination && appendAt) { appendAt = 0u; outResult.bPlacedFromZero = true; }
		insertMs = appendAt; insertIndex = target.Stages.size(); delta = last - first;
		if (appendAt + delta > MAX_EDITOR_TIME_MS)
			return reject("Paste would exceed the 600000 ms Pattern lifetime; current draft preserved.");
		if (splice && stageEnd < appendAt)
		{
			KOUKU_SAYDON_COMPOSITION_STAGE gap;
			gap.strStageKind = "RECOVERY"; gap.iDurationMs = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(appendAt - stageEnd);
			cloneStage(std::move(gap), false);
		}
	}
	// Paste keeps the gaps between selected clips like a mixed-lane duplicate.
	const bool cropToSpan = lanesSelected || paste;
	for (std::size_t index = 0; splice && index < source.Stages.size(); ++index)
	{
		const auto& original = source.Stages[index];
		const auto end = base + original.iDurationMs;
		const bool whole = selectedStages.contains(original.strStageId);
		auto copy = original;
		if (!whole) std::erase_if(copy.AnimationOccurrences, [&](const auto& box) { return !selected.contains(box.strOccurrenceId); });
		if (!cropToSpan)
		{
			if (whole || !copy.AnimationOccurrences.empty())
			{
				if (!whole)
				{
					std::uint32_t a = MAX_EDITOR_TIME_MS, b = 0;
					for (const auto& box : copy.AnimationOccurrences) { a = (std::min)(a, box.iStartOffsetMs); b = (std::max)(b, box.iStartOffsetMs + box.iPlayMs); }
					for (auto& box : copy.AnimationOccurrences) box.iStartOffsetMs -= a;
					copy.iDurationMs = b - a;
				}
				delta += copy.iDurationMs; cloneStage(std::move(copy), whole);
				insertIndex = index + 1u; insertMs = end;
			}
		}
		else if (base < last && end > first)
		{
			const auto a = (std::max)(base, first), b = (std::min)(end, last);
			copy.iDurationMs = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(b - a);
			if (!whole && copy.AnimationOccurrences.empty())
            { copy.bRetargetOnEnter = false; copy.RetargetTarget.reset(); }
			for (auto& box : copy.AnimationOccurrences) box.iStartOffsetMs -= static_cast<std::uint32_t>(a - base);
			cloneStage(std::move(copy), true);
			if (!paste) { insertIndex = index + 1u; insertMs = end; }
		}
		base = end;
	}
	if (cropToSpan && splice)
	{
		delta = last - first;
		if (last > total)
		{
			KOUKU_SAYDON_COMPOSITION_STAGE tail;
			tail.strStageKind = "RECOVERY";
			tail.iDurationMs = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(last - total);
			cloneStage(std::move(tail), true);
			if (!paste) { insertIndex = source.Stages.size(); insertMs = total; }
		}
	}
	if (!paste && !splice) { insertMs = atOriginalTime ? first : last; delta = atOriginalTime ? 0u : last - first; }
	if (exhausted) return reject(verb + " rejected; stable ID ordinals are exhausted.");
	if (!paste && ((splice && total + delta > MAX_EDITOR_TIME_MS) || (!splice && last + delta > MAX_EDITOR_TIME_MS)))
		return reject("Duplicate would exceed the 600000 ms timeline limit.");
	if (paste)
	{
		// The destination resolves its own pose chain; a blend into a clip that
		// did not travel with the copy is dropped instead of pointing at nothing.
		std::vector<std::pair<std::uint64_t, KOUKU_SAYDON_COMPOSITION_ANIMATION_OCCURRENCE*>> clips;
		std::uint64_t origin = 0u;
		for (auto& stage : stages)
		{
			for (auto& box : stage.AnimationOccurrences) clips.emplace_back(origin + box.iStartOffsetMs, &box);
			origin += stage.iDurationMs;
		}
		for (auto& [start, box] : clips)
		{
			box->iPoseStartMs = UINT32_MAX;
			if (!box->iBlendInMs) continue;
			const bool continued = std::any_of(clips.begin(), clips.end(), [&](const auto& other) {
				return other.second != box && other.first + other.second->iPlayMs == start; });
			if (!continued) { box->iBlendInMs = 0u; ++outResult.iDetachedBoundaryBlends; }
		}
	}
	if (!paste && splice && pattern->BossMotion)
	{
		auto& motion = *pattern->BossMotion;
		if (motion.iStartMs >= insertMs) { motion.iStartMs += static_cast<std::uint32_t>(delta); motion.iEndMs += static_cast<std::uint32_t>(delta); }
		else if (motion.iEndMs > insertMs) motion.iEndMs += static_cast<std::uint32_t>(delta);
		if (motion.iEndMs > insertMs)
			for (auto& key : motion.Keys) if (key.iTimeMs >= insertMs) key.iTimeMs += static_cast<std::uint32_t>(delta);
	}
	const auto shiftLane = [&](auto& rows) {
		for (auto& row : rows)
		{
			const std::uint64_t end = std::uint64_t(row.iStartMs) + row.iDurationMs;
			if (row.iStartMs >= insertMs) row.iStartMs += static_cast<std::uint32_t>(delta);
			else if (end > insertMs) row.iDurationMs += static_cast<std::uint32_t>(delta);
			if (std::uint64_t(row.iStartMs) + row.iDurationMs > MAX_EDITOR_TIME_MS) return false;
		}
		return true;
	};
	if (!paste && splice && (!shiftLane(pattern->LogicOccurrences) || !shiftLane(pattern->SummonOccurrences) ||
		!shiftLane(pattern->WorldOccurrences) || !shiftLane(pattern->SceneProfileOccurrences) || !shiftLane(pattern->PresentationOccurrences) || !shiftLane(pattern->PatternOccurrences)))
		return reject("Duplicate would move an existing lane beyond 600000 ms.");
	// New rows are indexed from the destination, which equals the source only in DUPLICATE modes.
	const std::size_t firstNewPresentation = pattern->PresentationOccurrences.size();
	const std::size_t firstNewLogic = pattern->LogicOccurrences.size();
	const auto cloneLane = [&](const auto& originals, auto& rows, std::uint32_t& ordinal, const char* family) {
		for (const auto& original : originals) if (selected.contains(original.strOccurrenceId))
		{
			auto copy = original;
			copy.strOccurrenceId = allocate(ordinal, targetId + family);
			copy.iStartMs = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(insertMs + original.iStartMs - first);
			ids.emplace(original.strOccurrenceId, copy.strOccurrenceId);
			newBoxSelection.push_back(copy.strOccurrenceId);
			rows.push_back(std::move(copy));
		}
	};
	cloneLane(source.PatternOccurrences, pattern->PatternOccurrences, pattern->iNextPatternOccurrenceOrdinal, ".pattern.");
	cloneLane(source.LogicOccurrences, pattern->LogicOccurrences, pattern->iNextLogicOccurrenceOrdinal, ".logic.");
	cloneLane(source.SummonOccurrences, pattern->SummonOccurrences, pattern->iNextSummonOccurrenceOrdinal, ".summon.");
	cloneLane(source.WorldOccurrences, pattern->WorldOccurrences, pattern->iNextWorldOccurrenceOrdinal, ".world.");
	cloneLane(source.SceneProfileOccurrences, pattern->SceneProfileOccurrences, pattern->iNextSceneProfileOccurrenceOrdinal, ".sceneprofile.");
	cloneLane(source.PresentationOccurrences, pattern->PresentationOccurrences, pattern->iNextPresentationOccurrenceOrdinal, ".presentation.");
	if (exhausted) return reject(verb + " rejected; stable ID ordinals are exhausted.");
	const auto remap = [](std::string& id, const auto& mapping) { const auto found = mapping.find(id); if (found != mapping.end()) id = found->second; };
	std::unordered_map<std::string, std::string> copiedGroupIds;
	std::unordered_set<std::string> usedGroupIds;
	for (const auto& row : pattern->PresentationOccurrences)
		if (!row.strSelectionGroupId.empty()) usedGroupIds.insert(row.strSelectionGroupId);
	for (std::size_t index = firstNewPresentation; index < pattern->PresentationOccurrences.size(); ++index)
	{
		auto& row = pattern->PresentationOccurrences[index];
		if (!row.strSelectionGroupId.empty())
		{
			auto [group, inserted] = copiedGroupIds.try_emplace(row.strSelectionGroupId);
			if (inserted)
			{
				do
				{
					const auto* resource = Find_PresentationResource(candidate, row.strResourceId);
					group->second = allocate(pattern->iNextPresentationOccurrenceOrdinal, targetId +
						(resource && resource->eKind == KOUKU_SAYDON_PRESENTATION_KIND::EFFECT ? ".effectgroup." : ".collidergroup."));
					if (exhausted) return reject(verb + " rejected; selection group IDs are exhausted.");
				} while (!usedGroupIds.insert(group->second).second);
			}
			row.strSelectionGroupId = group->second;
		}
		remap(row.strLogicOccurrenceId, ids);
		if (!row.strRegionId.empty()) { const auto old = row.strRegionId; row.strRegionId = row.strOccurrenceId + ".region"; regionIds.emplace(old, row.strRegionId); }
		// Copy already baked the pending placements into the clipboard snapshot.
		if (!paste) for (const auto& pending : m_StagedPresentationGeometry)
			if (pending.strPatternId == targetId && ids.contains(pending.Occurrence.strOccurrenceId) && ids.at(pending.Occurrence.strOccurrenceId) == row.strOccurrenceId)
			{
				const auto* resource = Find_PresentationResource(candidate, row.strResourceId);
				if (!resource || !Valid_PresentationPlacement(*resource, pending.Occurrence))
					return reject("Correct or revert the selected presentation placement before Duplicate.");
				Copy_PresentationPlacement(pending.Occurrence, row, resource->eKind == KOUKU_SAYDON_PRESENTATION_KIND::EFFECT);
				if (resource && !Valid_GameplayColliderScale(*resource, row))
					return reject("Collider scale must be finite and positive. Adjust Scale / size before Duplicate.");
			}
		remap(row.strWorldOccurrenceId, ids);
        remap(row.strAnchorPresentationOccurrenceId, ids);
	}
	// Copy-on-write for typed references in reusable Logic definitions. Shared
	// definitions and external card/master/motion references remain untouched.
	std::unordered_map<std::string, std::string> logicIds;
	const auto cloneLogic = [&](std::string& id) {
		if (const auto existing = logicIds.find(id); existing != logicIds.end()) { id = existing->second; return true; }
		const auto found = std::find_if(candidate.Logics.begin(), candidate.Logics.end(), [&](const auto& value) { return value.strLogicId == id; });
		if (found == candidate.Logics.end()) return false;
		auto copy = *found;
		for (auto& target : copy.TargetWorldOccurrenceIds) remap(target, ids);
		for (auto& target : copy.PlayerEntryEffectOccurrenceIds) remap(target, ids);
		for (auto& target : copy.ContactMotions) remap(target.strTargetWorldOccurrenceId, ids);
		remap(copy.strSummonOccurrenceId, ids);
        remap(copy.strBombPresentationOccurrenceId, ids);
        remap(copy.strBombExplosionPresentationOccurrenceId, ids);
        remap(copy.strBombSectorPresentationOccurrenceId, ids);
		remap(copy.strTargetLogicOccurrenceId, ids); remap(copy.strContactTargetWorldOccurrenceId, ids);
		for (auto& region : copy.RegionIds) remap(region, regionIds);
		if (paste)
		{
			// Across Patterns these row/group references would otherwise keep
			// pointing into the source Pattern; Ctrl+D leaves them as they are.
			remap(copy.strTrackingPresentationOccurrenceId, ids);
			for (auto& set : copy.RandomVolleyOccurrenceSets) for (auto& member : set) remap(member, ids);
			remap(copy.strFixedSelectionGroupId, copiedGroupIds);
			remap(copy.strSelectedEffectGroupId, copiedGroupIds);
		}
		if (copy == *found) return true;
		copy.strLogicId = allocate(candidate.iNextLogicOrdinal, "kakulsaydon.g1.logic.");
		copy.strDisplayName += " (copy)";
		logicIds.emplace(id, copy.strLogicId); id = copy.strLogicId;
		candidate.Logics.push_back(std::move(copy));
		return !exhausted;
	};
	for (std::size_t index = firstNewLogic; index < pattern->LogicOccurrences.size(); ++index)
	{
		auto& row = pattern->LogicOccurrences[index];
		remap(row.strHoldLogicOccurrenceId, ids);
		if (!cloneLogic(row.strLogicId)) return reject(verb + " Logic definition is unavailable or its IDs are exhausted.");
		for (auto* outcomes : { &row.OnSuccessLogicIds, &row.OnFailLogicIds, &row.OnTimeoutLogicIds })
			for (auto& id : *outcomes) if (!cloneLogic(id)) return reject(verb + " outcome definition is unavailable or its IDs are exhausted.");
	}
	if (paste)
	{
		// Lifetime follows in the caller through Extend_PatternLifetimeForAuthoredLanes.
		pattern->Stages.insert(pattern->Stages.end(), std::make_move_iterator(stages.begin()), std::make_move_iterator(stages.end()));
	}
	else if (splice)
	{
		pattern->Stages.insert(pattern->Stages.begin() + insertIndex, std::make_move_iterator(stages.begin()), std::make_move_iterator(stages.end()));
		if (pattern->iDurationMs) pattern->iDurationMs += static_cast<std::uint32_t>(delta);
	}
	else if (last + delta > total)
	{
		if (pattern->iDurationMs) pattern->iDurationMs = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(last + delta);
		else
		{
			if (pattern->Stages.empty()) return reject("Lane duplication requires a Pattern Stage clock.");
			pattern->Stages.back().iDurationMs += static_cast<std::uint32_t>(last + delta - total);
		}
	}
	return true;
}

void Client::CKoukuSaydonActionWorkbench::Select_ClonedTimelineRows(
	const std::string& targetId, TIMELINE_CLONE_RESULT result)
{
	Clear_TimelineSelection();
	m_strSelectedPatternId = targetId; m_strTimelineSelectionPatternId = targetId;
	m_TimelineSelectedStageIds = std::move(result.NewStageIds); m_TimelineSelectedOccurrenceIds = std::move(result.NewBoxIds);
	m_strSelectedStageId.clear(); m_strSelectedOccurrenceId.clear(); m_strSelectedPresentationOccurrenceId.clear();
	m_strSelectedLogicOccurrenceId.clear(); m_strSelectedSummonOccurrenceId.clear(); m_strSelectedWorldOccurrenceId.clear();
	m_strSelectedSceneProfileOccurrenceId.clear(); m_strSelectedPatternOccurrenceId.clear();
	if (!m_TimelineSelectedStageIds.empty()) m_strSelectedStageId = m_TimelineSelectedStageIds.back();
	const auto* current = Find_Pattern(m_Draft, targetId);
	for (const auto& id : m_TimelineSelectedOccurrenceIds)
		if (Find_Occurrence(*current, id)) m_strSelectedOccurrenceId = id;
		else if (Find_PresentationBox(*current, id)) m_strSelectedPresentationOccurrenceId = id;
	Normalize_Selection(); Synchronize_EditorFields(); m_bFitRequested = false;
}

bool_t Client::CKoukuSaydonActionWorkbench::Duplicate_TimelineSelection(
	const std::string_view patternId, const std::vector<std::string>& stageIds,
	const std::vector<std::string>& occurrenceIds, std::string& outStatus, const bool_t atOriginalTime)
{
	const auto reject = [&](const std::string& message) { outStatus = m_strStatus = message; return false; };
	if (stageIds.empty() && occurrenceIds.empty()) return reject("Select timeline boxes to duplicate.");
	auto candidate = m_Draft;
	auto* pattern = Find_Pattern(candidate, patternId);
	if (!pattern || !pattern->strLoadError.empty()) return reject("Duplicate target Pattern is unavailable or invalid.");
	const auto source = *pattern;
	const std::string targetId = source.strPatternId;
	TIMELINE_CLONE_RESULT result;
	if (!Clone_TimelineSelectionInto(candidate, source, *pattern, stageIds, occurrenceIds,
		atOriginalTime ? TIMELINE_CLONE_MODE::DUPLICATE_SAME_TIME : TIMELINE_CLONE_MODE::DUPLICATE_AFTER, result, outStatus))
		return reject(outStatus);
	const auto isCopiedCollider = [&](const std::string& id) {
		const auto* box = Find_PresentationBox(*pattern, id);
		const auto* resource = box ? Find_PresentationResource(candidate, box->strResourceId) : nullptr;
		return resource && resource->eKind == KOUKU_SAYDON_PRESENTATION_KIND::COLLIDER;
	};
	const bool colliderAtOriginalTime = atOriginalTime &&
		std::any_of(result.NewBoxIds.begin(), result.NewBoxIds.end(), isCopiedCollider);
	if (colliderAtOriginalTime)
		std::erase_if(result.NewBoxIds, [&](const auto& id) { return !isCopiedCollider(id); });
	Mark_Draft(candidate, *pattern);
	if (!Commit_Candidate(std::move(candidate), atOriginalTime ?
		"Duplicated the selected boxes at the same times with their owned links. The copies are selected; adjust their placement and Save." :
		"Duplicated selected timeline boxes and their owned links. Following clocks preserved. Press Save.", outStatus)) return false;
	Select_ClonedTimelineRows(targetId, std::move(result));
	// A Collider detail duplicate retains its new Collider selection, while its
	// copied Logic remains owned by those rows. Ctrl+D and Effect behavior stay unchanged.
	if (!colliderAtOriginalTime) m_strSelectedPresentationOccurrenceId.clear();
	Synchronize_EditorFields();
	if (atOriginalTime)
	{
		// A running preview owns a document snapshot. Admit the newly allocated
		// occurrence IDs before subsequent group geometry edits target them.
		const bool pending = m_bPatternPreviewRequestPending && m_PendingPatternPreview.strPatternId == targetId;
		const bool playing = m_PreviewState.bPlaying && m_PreviewState.strPatternId == targetId;
		const auto clockMs = pending ? m_iPendingPreviewStartMs : playing ? m_PreviewState.iClockMs :
			m_strCursorPatternId == targetId ? m_iCursorMs : 0u;
		const bool paused = pending ? m_bPendingPreviewStartPaused : !playing || m_PreviewState.bPaused;
		const std::string copiedStatus = outStatus;
		std::string previewStatus;
		if (!Request_PatternPreview(targetId, clockMs, previewStatus, paused))
			outStatus = m_strStatus = copiedStatus + " Preview is unavailable: " + previewStatus;
		else outStatus = m_strStatus = copiedStatus;
	}
	return true;
}

bool_t Client::CKoukuSaydonActionWorkbench::Delete_TimelineSelection(
	const std::string_view patternId, const std::vector<std::string>& stageIds,
	const std::vector<std::string>& occurrenceIds, std::string& outStatus)
{
	const auto reject = [&](const std::string& reason) { outStatus = m_strStatus = reason; return false; };
	if (stageIds.empty() && occurrenceIds.empty()) return reject("Select timeline boxes to delete.");
	auto candidate = m_Draft;
	auto* pattern = Find_Pattern(candidate, patternId);
	if (!pattern || !pattern->strLoadError.empty()) return reject("Delete target Pattern is unavailable or invalid.");
	const std::string targetId = pattern->strPatternId;
	std::unordered_set<std::string> stages(stageIds.begin(), stageIds.end()), boxes(occurrenceIds.begin(), occurrenceIds.end());
	for (const auto& id : stages) if (!Find_Stage(*pattern, id)) return reject("Delete Stage is unavailable: " + id);
	for (const auto& id : boxes) if (!Has_TimelineOccurrence(*pattern, id)) return reject("Delete box is unavailable: " + id);
	// Deleting an Object removes its owned companion, as the single-row command does.
	// A capture Trigger owns its Hold only while no surviving Trigger shares it.
	for (const auto& row : pattern->LogicOccurrences)
		if (boxes.contains(row.strOccurrenceId) && !row.strHoldLogicOccurrenceId.empty() &&
			std::none_of(pattern->LogicOccurrences.begin(), pattern->LogicOccurrences.end(), [&](const auto& other) {
				return !boxes.contains(other.strOccurrenceId) && other.strHoldLogicOccurrenceId == row.strHoldLogicOccurrenceId; }))
			boxes.insert(row.strHoldLogicOccurrenceId);
	for (auto& row : pattern->LogicOccurrences)
		if (boxes.contains(row.strHoldLogicOccurrenceId)) row.strHoldLogicOccurrenceId.clear();
	for (const auto& row : pattern->PresentationOccurrences)
		if (!row.strLogicOccurrenceId.empty() && boxes.contains(row.strLogicOccurrenceId)) boxes.insert(row.strOccurrenceId);
	for (const auto& row : pattern->PresentationOccurrences)
		if (!row.strWorldOccurrenceId.empty() && boxes.contains(row.strWorldOccurrenceId)) boxes.insert(row.strOccurrenceId);
	std::vector<std::pair<std::uint64_t, std::uint64_t>> removed;
	std::uint64_t base = 0;
	for (const auto& stage : pattern->Stages)
	{
		if (stages.contains(stage.strStageId)) removed.emplace_back(base, base + stage.iDurationMs);
		base += stage.iDurationMs;
	}
	const auto mappedTime = [&](const std::uint64_t time) {
		std::uint64_t result = time;
		for (const auto& [first, last] : removed)
			if (time > first) result -= (std::min)(time, last) - first;
		return result;
	};
	const auto eraseLane = [&](auto& rows) {
		std::erase_if(rows, [&](const auto& row) { return boxes.contains(row.strOccurrenceId); });
		for (auto& row : rows)
		{
			const auto begin = mappedTime(row.iStartMs), end = mappedTime(std::uint64_t(row.iStartMs) + row.iDurationMs);
			if (row.iDurationMs && end == begin) return false;
			row.iStartMs = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(begin); row.iDurationMs = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(end - begin);
		}
		return true;
	};
	if (!eraseLane(pattern->LogicOccurrences) || !eraseLane(pattern->SummonOccurrences) ||
		!eraseLane(pattern->WorldOccurrences) || !eraseLane(pattern->SceneProfileOccurrences) || !eraseLane(pattern->PresentationOccurrences) || !eraseLane(pattern->PatternOccurrences))
		return reject("The removed Stage contains an unselected lane box. Select that box too before Delete.");
	if (pattern->BossMotion && !removed.empty())
	{
		auto& motion = *pattern->BossMotion;
		const auto startMs = mappedTime(motion.iStartMs), endMs = mappedTime(motion.iEndMs);
		if (endMs <= startMs)
			return reject("This selection removes the whole Boss Motion interval. Disable Move boss during Pattern before deleting that complete interval.");
		// Animation splices change the movement clock, preserving authored
		// positions and yaw. The same time mapping already retimes other lanes.
		motion.iStartMs = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(startMs);
		motion.iEndMs = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(endMs);
		for (auto& key : motion.Keys) key.iTimeMs = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(mappedTime(key.iTimeMs));
		for (std::size_t i = 1u; i < motion.Keys.size(); ++i)
			if (motion.Keys[i].iTimeMs <= motion.Keys[i - 1u].iTimeMs)
				return reject("Delete collapses sampled Boss Motion keys. Keep their timeline interval or disable Move boss during Pattern first.");
	}
	if (pattern->iDurationMs && !removed.empty()) pattern->iDurationMs = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(mappedTime(pattern->iDurationMs));
	std::erase_if(pattern->Stages, [&](const auto& stage) { return stages.contains(stage.strStageId); });
	for (auto& stage : pattern->Stages)
		std::erase_if(stage.AnimationOccurrences, [&](const auto& row) { return boxes.contains(row.strOccurrenceId); });
	Mark_Draft(candidate, *pattern);
	if (!Commit_Candidate(std::move(candidate), "Deleted selected timeline boxes. Press Save.", outStatus)) return false;
	std::erase_if(m_StagedPresentationGeometry, [&](const auto& row) { return row.strPatternId == targetId && boxes.contains(row.Occurrence.strOccurrenceId); });
	Clear_TimelineSelection();
	m_bFitRequested = false;
	return true;
}

void Client::CKoukuSaydonActionWorkbench::Clear_TimelineSelection()
{
	m_strTimelineSelectionPatternId.clear();
	m_TimelineSelectedStageIds.clear();
	m_TimelineSelectedOccurrenceIds.clear();
	m_bTimelineMarqueeActive = false;
	m_iTimelineDragMode = -1;
	m_strTimelineGroupDragOccurrenceId.clear();
	m_TimelineGroupDragOccurrenceIds.clear();
}

void Client::CKoukuSaydonActionWorkbench::Select_TimelineBox(
	const std::string& stageId, const std::string& occurrenceId, const bool_t toggle)
{
	// All-lane Sequencer selection: stable occurrence IDs, typed Detail focus.
	const auto* pattern = Find_Pattern(m_Draft, m_strSelectedPatternId);
	if (!pattern) return;
	const auto isOccurrence = [&](const std::string& id) {
		return Find_PatternBox(*pattern, id) || Find_Occurrence(*pattern, id) || Find_LogicBox(*pattern, id) ||
			Find_SummonBox(*pattern, id) || Find_WorldBox(*pattern, id) ||
			Find_SceneProfileBox(*pattern, id) || Find_PresentationBox(*pattern, id);
	};
	if (occurrenceId.empty() ? !Find_Stage(*pattern, stageId) : !isOccurrence(occurrenceId)) return;
	const std::string selectedId = occurrenceId.empty() ? stageId : occurrenceId;
	if (!toggle)
	{
		m_TimelineSelectedStageIds.clear();
		m_TimelineSelectedOccurrenceIds.clear();
	}
	auto& selected = occurrenceId.empty() ? m_TimelineSelectedStageIds : m_TimelineSelectedOccurrenceIds;
	std::vector<std::string> clickedIds{selectedId};
	if (!occurrenceId.empty()) Expand_PresentationSelection(*pattern, clickedIds);
	const bool removed = toggle && std::all_of(clickedIds.begin(), clickedIds.end(), [&](const auto& id) {
		return std::find(selected.begin(), selected.end(), id) != selected.end(); });
	for (const auto& id : clickedIds)
	{
		const auto found = std::find(selected.begin(), selected.end(), id);
		if (removed && found != selected.end()) selected.erase(found);
		else if (!removed && found == selected.end()) selected.push_back(id);
	}
	std::string focusStage = occurrenceId.empty() ? selectedId : std::string{};
	std::string focusOccurrence = occurrenceId.empty() ? std::string{} : selectedId;
	if (removed)
	{
		focusStage.clear(); focusOccurrence.clear();
		if (!m_TimelineSelectedOccurrenceIds.empty()) focusOccurrence = m_TimelineSelectedOccurrenceIds.back();
		else if (!m_TimelineSelectedStageIds.empty()) focusStage = m_TimelineSelectedStageIds.back();
	}
	m_strSelectedStageId.clear();
	m_strSelectedOccurrenceId.clear();
	m_strSelectedLogicOccurrenceId.clear();
	m_strSelectedSummonOccurrenceId.clear();
	m_strSelectedWorldOccurrenceId.clear();
	m_strSelectedSceneProfileOccurrenceId.clear();
	m_strSelectedPresentationOccurrenceId.clear(); m_strSelectedPatternOccurrenceId.clear();
	const KOUKU_SAYDON_COMPOSITION_STAGE* animationStage = nullptr;
	if (!focusOccurrence.empty())
	{
		if (Find_Occurrence(*pattern, focusOccurrence, &animationStage))
		{
			m_strSelectedStageId = animationStage->strStageId;
			m_strSelectedOccurrenceId = focusOccurrence;
		}
		else if (Find_PatternBox(*pattern, focusOccurrence)) m_strSelectedPatternOccurrenceId = focusOccurrence;
		else if (Find_LogicBox(*pattern, focusOccurrence)) m_strSelectedLogicOccurrenceId = focusOccurrence;
		else if (Find_SummonBox(*pattern, focusOccurrence)) m_strSelectedSummonOccurrenceId = focusOccurrence;
		else if (Find_WorldBox(*pattern, focusOccurrence)) m_strSelectedWorldOccurrenceId = focusOccurrence;
		else if (Find_SceneProfileBox(*pattern, focusOccurrence)) m_strSelectedSceneProfileOccurrenceId = focusOccurrence;
		else if (Find_PresentationBox(*pattern, focusOccurrence)) m_strSelectedPresentationOccurrenceId = focusOccurrence;
	}
	else m_strSelectedStageId = focusStage;
	m_strTimelineSelectionPatternId = m_strSelectedPatternId;
	Synchronize_EditorFields();
}


void Client::CKoukuSaydonActionWorkbench::Rebuild_PatternChildRows(
    const KOUKU_SAYDON_COMPOSITION_PATTERN& parent)
{
    if (m_iChildRowsGeneration == m_iDraftGeneration && m_strChildRowsPattern == parent.strPatternId) return;
    m_iChildRowsGeneration = m_iDraftGeneration; m_strChildRowsPattern = parent.strPatternId;
    m_PatternChildRows.clear(); m_strChildRowsStatus.clear();
    if (parent.PatternOccurrences.empty()) return;
    KOUKU_SAYDON_COMPOSITION_DOCUMENT expanded;
    if (!CKoukuSaydonCompositionDocument::Try_ExpandPatternDocument(m_Draft, parent.strPatternId, expanded, m_strChildRowsStatus)) return;
    const auto* result = Find_Pattern(expanded, parent.strPatternId);
    if (!result) return;
    std::unordered_map<std::string, std::pair<std::uint32_t, std::uint32_t>> times;
    std::uint32_t clock = 0u;
    for (const auto& stage : result->Stages)
    {
        for (const auto& row : stage.AnimationOccurrences)
            times.emplace(row.strOccurrenceId, std::make_pair(clock + row.iStartOffsetMs, row.iPlayMs));
        clock += stage.iDurationMs;
    }
    const auto timeLane = [&](const auto& rows) {
        for (const auto& row : rows) times.emplace(row.strOccurrenceId, std::make_pair(row.iStartMs, row.iDurationMs));
    };
    timeLane(result->LogicOccurrences); timeLane(result->SummonOccurrences); timeLane(result->WorldOccurrences);
    timeLane(result->SceneProfileOccurrences); timeLane(result->PresentationOccurrences);
    for (const auto& box : parent.PatternOccurrences)
    {
        const auto* child = Find_Pattern(m_Draft, box.strPatternId);
        if (!child) continue; // Expansion already diagnosed invalid children.
        const auto duration = Pattern_DurationMs(*child);
        if (!duration) continue;
        for (std::uint32_t repeat = 0u; repeat < 64u && std::uint64_t(repeat) * duration < box.iDurationMs; ++repeat)
        {
            // Resolve only IDs actually emitted by the existing expander. The
            // UI retains original owner IDs; derived repeat IDs are never edited.
            const auto scope = box.strOccurrenceId + ".r" + std::to_string(repeat);
            const auto add = [&](const std::string& runtimeId, const std::string& stageId,
                const std::string& sourceId, const std::string& label, const std::uint32_t color) {
                const auto found = times.find(runtimeId);
                if (found == times.end()) return;
                m_PatternChildRows.push_back({runtimeId, child->strPatternId, stageId, sourceId,
                    child->strDisplayName + " / " + label, found->second.first, found->second.second, color});
            };
            std::size_t animationIndex = 0u;
            for (const auto& stage : child->Stages)
                for (const auto& row : stage.AnimationOccurrences)
                    add(scope + ".animation." + std::to_string(++animationIndex), stage.strStageId,
                        row.strOccurrenceId, "Animation / " + row.strRuntimeClip, IM_COL32(80, 145, 205, 255));
            const auto lane = [&](const auto& rows, const char* kind, const char* label, const std::uint32_t color) {
                for (std::size_t i = 0u; i < rows.size(); ++i)
                    add(scope + "." + kind + "." + std::to_string(i + 1u), {}, rows[i].strOccurrenceId,
                        std::string(label) + " / " + rows[i].strOccurrenceId, color);
            };
            lane(child->LogicOccurrences, "logic", "Logic", IM_COL32(185, 125, 65, 255));
            lane(child->SummonOccurrences, "summon", "Summon", IM_COL32(150, 125, 85, 255));
            lane(child->WorldOccurrences, "world", "World", IM_COL32(80, 160, 100, 255));
            lane(child->SceneProfileOccurrences, "sceneprofile", "Scene Profile", IM_COL32(100, 130, 170, 255));
            for (std::size_t i = 0u; i < child->PresentationOccurrences.size(); ++i)
            {
                const auto& row = child->PresentationOccurrences[i];
                const auto* resource = Find_DraftPresentationResource(row.strResourceId);
                const auto label = resource ? resource->strDisplayName : row.strResourceId;
                add(scope + ".presentation." + std::to_string(i + 1u), {}, row.strOccurrenceId,
                    std::string(resource ? Presentation_Label(resource->eKind) : "Presentation") + " / " + label, IM_COL32(130, 100, 190, 255));
            }
            if (!box.bRepeat) break;
        }
    }
}

void Client::CKoukuSaydonActionWorkbench::Render_Timeline()
{
	if (m_ePatternSelection != KOUKU_PATTERN_SELECTION::PATTERN && m_ePatternSelection != KOUKU_PATTERN_SELECTION::BUNDLE)
		Render_EditHistoryButtons("EmptyTimelineHistory");
	const auto& io = ImGui::GetIO();
	const bool additiveSelection = io.KeyCtrl || io.KeyShift;
	Engine::CProfilerScope paneScope(CGameInstance::Get().Get_Profiler(), "ImGui.Composition.Timeline");
	Render_CompleteSequenceTransport();
	if (m_ePatternSelection == KOUKU_PATTERN_SELECTION::BUNDLE) { Render_BundleTimeline(); return; }
	if (m_ePatternSelection == KOUKU_PATTERN_SELECTION::FOLDER)
	{
		const auto* folder = Find_Folder(m_Draft, m_strSelectedFolderId);
		if (!folder) { ImGui::TextDisabled("The selected Parent is unavailable."); return; }
		ImGui::SeparatorText("Parent Timeline");
		ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", folder->strDisplayName.c_str());
		if (!folder->strLoadError.empty()) { ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", folder->strLoadError.c_str()); return; }
		ImGui::TextWrapped("This Parent has no timeline yet. Use Append Pattern beside Publish All Patterns to place a complete child Pattern, or create an empty timeline to edit common Animation, Effect, Logic and World rows.");
		ImGui::BeginDisabled(!m_bHasDraft || !m_Document.Is_Fresh());
		if (ImGui::Button("Create Parent Timeline##Sequencer"))
		{ const auto folderId = folder->strFolderId; std::string status; (void)Create_ParentTimeline(folderId, status); }
		ImGui::EndDisabled();
		if (!m_strStatus.empty()) ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", m_strStatus.c_str());
		return;
	}
	if (m_ePatternSelection != KOUKU_PATTERN_SELECTION::PATTERN) { ImGui::TextDisabled("Select a Parent, playback bundle or Pattern to edit its sequence."); return; }
	if (m_strTimelineSelectionPatternId != m_strSelectedPatternId)
	{
		Clear_TimelineSelection();
		m_strTimelineSelectionPatternId = m_strSelectedPatternId;
	}
	const auto* pattern = Find_Pattern(m_Draft, m_strSelectedPatternId);
	const bool_t patternReady = nullptr != pattern && pattern->strLoadError.empty();
	const std::string patternId = nullptr == pattern ? std::string{} : pattern->strPatternId;
	if (patternReady && Find_TimelineParent(m_Draft, patternId))
	{
		ImGui::TextDisabled("Parent child Pattern boxes: %zu", pattern->PatternOccurrences.size());
        if (pattern->PatternOccurrences.empty())
        {
            std::vector<KOUKU_SAYDON_COMPOSITION_CROSS_DIRECTION_WINDOW> directions;
            std::string resolveStatus;
            if (CKoukuSaydonCompositionDocument::Try_ResolveCrossDirectionWindows(m_Draft, *pattern, directions, resolveStatus) &&
                !directions.empty())
                ImGui::TextWrapped("This Parent runs its four-direction Summon. Separate child Pattern boxes are unnecessary; the Summon chooses one real body and three clones.");
            else if (!pattern->Stages.empty() || !pattern->LogicOccurrences.empty() || !pattern->SummonOccurrences.empty() ||
                !pattern->WorldOccurrences.empty() || !pattern->SceneProfileOccurrences.empty() || !pattern->PresentationOccurrences.empty())
                ImGui::TextWrapped("This Parent plays its common timeline rows. A named Summon needs a configured playback policy or explicit spawned Patterns to create actors.");
            else
                ImGui::TextWrapped("This Parent has no playback rows yet. Append a Pattern or add an Animation, Effect, Logic, Summon or World row.");
        }
	}
	// All-lane Sequencer selection: stable occurrence IDs, typed Detail focus.
	// Append/Detail paths may initially focus a box without a batch selection.
	if (patternReady && m_TimelineSelectedStageIds.empty() && m_TimelineSelectedOccurrenceIds.empty())
		for (const auto* id : { &m_strSelectedOccurrenceId, &m_strSelectedLogicOccurrenceId,
			&m_strSelectedSummonOccurrenceId, &m_strSelectedWorldOccurrenceId,
			&m_strSelectedSceneProfileOccurrenceId, &m_strSelectedPresentationOccurrenceId, &m_strSelectedPatternOccurrenceId })
			if (!id->empty()) { m_TimelineSelectedOccurrenceIds.push_back(*id); break; }
	const auto canReorderSelection = [&]() {
		return patternReady && (!m_TimelineSelectedStageIds.empty() || !m_TimelineSelectedOccurrenceIds.empty()) &&
			std::all_of(m_TimelineSelectedOccurrenceIds.begin(), m_TimelineSelectedOccurrenceIds.end(),
				[&](const auto& id) { return nullptr != Find_Occurrence(*pattern, id); });
	};
	const auto durationMs = patternReady ? Pattern_DurationMs(*pattern) : 0u;
	if (m_strCursorPatternId != patternId)
	{
		m_strCursorPatternId = patternId;
		m_iCursorMs = 0u;
	}
	m_iCursorMs = (std::min)(m_iCursorMs, durationMs);
	const bool_t patternPreview = patternReady && m_PreviewState.bPlaying &&
		m_PreviewState.strPatternId == patternId;
	const bool_t serverPlayback = !m_bSequenceWorkspace &&
		CKoukuSaydonPatternAuditionService::Get().Get_Snapshot().Is_InFlight();
	const bool_t canPlayPattern = patternReady && durationMs > 0u && !serverPlayback && !m_bServerPlayPreparationPending;
	if (serverPlayback && m_bServerSelectionFollowSuspended)
		ImGui::TextDisabled("Server playback continues. Automatic selection is paused to preserve editor input.");
	const bool_t publishing = Is_PublishRunning();
	ImGui::BeginDisabled(publishing || !m_bHasDraft || !Is_Dirty());
	const bool_t saveRequested = ImGui::Button("Save##KoukuSequencer");
	ImGui::EndDisabled();
	ImGui::SameLine();
	ImGui::BeginDisabled(!canPlayPattern);
